title: Relocate to  Full Stack Developer
description:
Our client's Microsoft Business Solutions team is a Microsoft Gold Partner and leader in Microsoft software implementations for medium to large organisations, providing their clients with the ability to keep up with the ever-changing digital world by implementing Microsoft's Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) and Customer Engagement (CE) software from the Microsoft Dynamics 365 (D365) software line.

Role Overview

A Senior Full Stack Developer is an individual who has a solid background in development, leads architectural discussions and decisions and takes initiatives to improve or create new standards. A Senior Full Stack Developer will act as a proxy between the development teams and clients and will be working closely with software developers amongst other stakeholders.

Job Location: Sliema, Malta

Work Type: Hybrid

Job Type: Full-time, Permanent

Working Hours: GMT +1

Salary: Base + Benefits (Paid in Euros €)

Relocation: VISA & Relocation Package Included

Requirements

  • A minimum of 6-8 years hands on experience in the IT sector.
  • Proficient with object-oriented-programming (OOP) concepts.
  • Proficient in algorithms and data structures.
  • Proficient in relational databases.
  • Experienced in asynchronous programming.
  • Experienced of different software development lifecycles.
  • Experienced as a full-stack developer with experience with React.js (Frontend) and .NET Framework (Backend).
  • Experienced in Single-Page-Applications using a recent JavaScript framework.
  • Experienced in popular source control.
  • Experienced in cloud-based services.
  • Knowledge with document-based databases.
  • Knowledge of containerization.
  • Awareness of DevOps
  • Fluency, both written and verbal, in English.
  • Good eye for detail.
  • Capable of taking self-initiative to learn and deliver.
  • Working in a team environment.
  • Ability to understand, discuss, and influence business requirements.
  • Capable of being flexible and adapting onto different technologies.
  • Mentor and guide colleagues.
  • Excellent organisation and prioritising skills.
  • Software design.
  • Accountability & Ownership
  • Integrity, Honesty & Transparency
  • Quality & Excellence
  • Skilled Problem Solving
  • Communication & Teamwork
  • Customer Centricity

Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with software developers in their daily duties.
  • Utilise technical knowledge and experience to mentor, delegate and assist other developers.
  • Coach and motivate team members, mitigating impediments affecting the team.
  • Drive engagement and motivation to sustain talent and reduce attrition rate.
  • Cooperate with multiple teams in implementing new ideas.
  • Drive internal process improvements across multiple teams and functions.
  • Working with the team to develop programming guidelines/standards and ensure they are adopted and followed by the entire development team.
  • Maintain and set appropriate standards and technical processes, including productivity enhancements, quality measures, and customer-oriented standards.
  • Influence ways of working by participating in various technical discussions and ensure that there is alignment within other development teams.
  • Keeping up to date with emerging technologies and proposing technical advances based on newer technologies.
  • Sharing of knowledge and distribution of responsibilities to elevate team knowledge and eliminate/mitigate points of failure.
  • Continually implementing and fine-tuning processes that increase efficiency in testing, developing, and releasing updates.
  • Participate in project related ceremonies.
  • Working in an Agile, Waterfall or DevOps approach depending on the business requirements.
  • Adhere to best practices and our client's technical standards during the lifecycle of a project.
  • Make use of tools, standards, technologies, and frameworks that are used within the team and on projects.
  • Take ownership and lead the development, improving and troubleshooting of tasks.
  • Work with minimal supervision.
  • Translate business requirements into technical solutions.
  • Ability to look at a problem and come up with practical solutions.
  • Engage with clients and propose innovative ideas on project tasks.
  • Maintain a quality-oriented mindset with testable code.
  • Identify testable areas and contribute towards increasing code coverage.
  • Engaging with stakeholders across the business in terms of understanding business priorities, communicating progress, highlighting success and delivery risks, and managing expectations in line with the roadmap.
  • Communicate progress updates to relevant parties both formally and informally.
  • Lead project architectural design.
  • Perform technology research and develop proof-of-concepts and functional prototypes.
  • Develop and build code with a mindset for reusability and maintainability.
  • Performing impact analysis of any code changes.
  • Contribute towards code quality by taking part in code reviews.
  • Implementation of efficient and performant code.
  • Edit and own project related documentation.
  • Provide estimates for requests, fixes, and new ideas.
  • Contribute to the recruitment process.
  • To perform any other additional duties that may arise from time to time.

Microsoft Business Solutions Overview

Your long-term future is every bit as important to our client as it is to you. That's why their aim is to give you experiences that will stay with you for a lifetime. Whether it's great training and development, mobility opportunities or corporate responsibility volunteering activities – you'll gain a wealth of experiences on which to build a rewarding career. Our client is a firm that encourages you to be yourself, values your contribution, and inspires you to act as a role model, always focused on doing the right thing for each other, their clients, and their communities.

This sets out all the different ways you'll be rewarded at the firm. Among other things, you can benefit from honest conversations about your career as well as a range of other rewards. In all these ways and more, they have created an environment that can bring out the best in you.

#Bethechange and #makethechange. Join our client's talented, successful team and make the leap into the future.

Don't worry, our client knows that relocation can be a challenge, which is why they have an extremely supportive onboarding team to help you throughout this process - They provide relocation support for you and your family. Our client is looking forward to meeting you and seeing you grow.

title: Evaluation Scenario Writer
description:
Please submit your CV in English and indicate your level of English proficiency.

Mindrift connects specialists with project-based AI opportunities for leading tech companies, focused on testing, evaluating, and improving AI systems. Participation isproject-based, not permanent employment.

What this opportunity involves

You'll create challenging coding test cases that push AI coding systems to their limits:

  • Review and refine realistic coding tasks based on provided production codebases with realistic scope, requirements and information sources 
  • Write comprehensive functional tests that validate actual end-to-end behavior and edge-cases, not just superficial checks
  • Craft "fair but hard" challenges where the AI has all the context it needs, but has to work for it (information scattered across files and external sources, complex reasoning required)
  • Analyze AI failures to understand what the model struggles with vs. what it masters
  • Iterate based on feedback from expert QA reviewers who score your work on 7 quality criteria

What we look for

This opportunity is a good fit for experienced developers, software engineers, and/or test automation specialists open to part-time, non-permanent projects. Ideally, contributors will have: 

  • Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or related fields
  • 5+ years in software development, primarily Python (pytest, async/await, subprocess, file operations)
  • Background in Full-Stack development, with an equal focus on building React-based interfaces and robust Back-end systems
  • Experience writing tests (functional, integration – not just running them)
  • Docker containers (running evaluations locally in containers)
  • CI/CD understanding (GitHub Actions as a user: triggers, labels, reading results)
  • English proficiency - B2

How it works

Apply → Pass qualification(s) → Join a project → Complete tasks → Get paid

Effort estimate 

Tasks for this project are estimated to take 20 hours to complete, depending on complexity. This is an estimate and not a schedule requirement; you choose when and how to work. Tasks must be submitted by the deadline and meet the listed acceptance criteria to be accepted.

Payment

  • Paid contributions, with rates up to $17/hour*
  • Fixed project rate or individual rates, depending on the project
  • Some projects include incentive payments

*Note: Rates vary based on expertise, skills assessment, location, project needs, and other factors. Higher rates may be offered to highly specialized experts. Lower rates may apply during onboarding or non-core project phases. Payment details are shared per project.

title: auxiliar de cozinha
description:
Desde dezembro de 2015, a SPDM/PAIS é responsável, em parceria com a Secretaria Municipal de Saúde do Rio de Janeiro, pelo gerenciamento do Hospital Municipal Pedro II.
A infraestrutura do Hospital conta com dez andares, nos quais estão distribuídos os serviços de emergência e de Unidade de Tratamento Intensivo (UTI) adulta, pediátrica e neonatal; maternidade; clínica médica, cirurgia-geral e bucomaxilofacial, neurocirurgia, psiquiatria, pediatria e ortopedia. Exames de imagem (raio X, tomografia, ultrassonografia, eletrocardiografia, ecocardiografia) e laboratoriais também são realizados na unidade.
Devido à grande população de idosos da Zona Oeste, região assistida pelo Hospital Municipal Pedro II (HMPII), há duas Enfermarias destinadas ao atendimento desse público.
O Centro de Tratamento de Queimados é outro diferencial entre os serviços oferecidos, e que dispõe de uma UTI exclusiva para prevenir infecções, que podem ser muito graves para quem está com queimaduras.
Além disso, a unidade conta com a Coordenação de Emergência Regional (CER) Santa Cruz, que possui 39 leitos, e tem como objetivo absorver as demandas de menor complexidade, deixando o HMPII liberado para os casos de risco iminente de morte, necessidade de cirurgia urgente e/ou internação. Um diferencial deste CER é o fato de possuir atendimento especializado em Psiquiatria e Obstetrícia.
Responsabilidades e atribuições
Auxiliar nas tarefas de preparo de alimentos, que serão servidos para os pacientes, conforme orientação do cozinheiro, da técnica ou do Nutricionista, efetuando tarefas de apoio.
Requisitos e qualificações
Ensino Fundamental Completo
Experiência mínima de 06 meses na função.
Informações adicionais
Profissionais de empresas parceiras, fornecedores e/ou prestadores de serviços, vínculo com grau de parentesco ou afinidade no mesmo serviço ou que atuam em outra modalidade contratual (vínculo com o prestador), deverão observar normativas de RH vigentes, através de consulta junto ao setor de Recrutamento e Seleção.

Understanding of subsurface velocity models

Programming

Seismic interpretation

Busca constante pela melhoria contínua, buscando atualizações e conhecimentos adicionais para aprimorar suas habilidades clínicas;

Registrar as intercorrências durante o plantão e avisar ao seu superior para tomadas de decisão.

title: Junior Legal Counsel
description:
About Us

GSCF | | Rio de Janeiro – Brazil (Hybrid)

GSCF is a leading fintech company in the working capital finance space, serving some of the largest tech manufacturers globally. By funding, structuring, and servicing accounts receivables portfolios for our customers, we help companies get the most out of their working capital. We help our customers grow their sales, strengthen their balance sheets, and eliminate risk.

Our formation in 2021 gives us a start-up culture and mindset, while our origins bring deep industry knowledge, extensive specialized expertise, and geographic reach across 59 countries. Despite being a new player in our space, GSCF serviced more than $60 billion in tech accounts receivables volumes in 2021. We are wholly owned and funded by Blackstone, the world's largest alternative asset manager, which provides us with a large and flexible funding pool, significant relationships, and strategic guidance.

Our field, global working capital finance, represents a $5.5 trillion total addressable market that is expected to grow an additional 50% by 2026, driven by increased supply chain complexity, digitization of the invoicing process and growing demand for longer payment terms. Our aim is to become the global leader in the working capital finance space.

GSCF is a global employer with more than 300 employees across 20+ countries.

The role:

The Junior Legal Counsel will work closely with the General Counsel and play a key role in working on Peridot's complex and sophisticated commercial financing business, investment, and other corporate matters to ensure Peridot's legal needs are fully met.

The position is based in Brazil and includes continuous interaction with the General Counsel in New York, and colleagues and business partners located worldwide.

How You Will Make an Impact:

  • Assist in drafting, reviewing, and supporting negotiating of commercial agreements and legal contracts, including trade financing agreements, loan documents, guarantees, vendor contracts, NDAs, and related financing documents.
  • Assist with legal entity administration and support corporate governance activities across multiple countries, including helping prepare organizational and compliance filing materials.
  • Support legal entity administration and maintain compliance record for local operations.
  • Assist in drafting and reviewing statutory and other corporate documents and provide basic support on corporate law matters under supervision.
  • Coordinate with internal business and operations including credit, tax, treasury, operations, etc. in connection with legal reviews.
  • Conduct basic legal research and provide guidance on regulatory requirements applicable to Peridot's business globally.
    Correspond with local counsel regarding documentation and team questions and coordinate review by such counsel.

What You Bring to the Team:

  • Fluent Portuguese, English and Spanish;
  • Bachelor or university degree in law (or equivalent);
  • Work experience: 1 year of experience in legal support, contracts or corporate law;
  • Basic knowledge of contract law and corporate governance ;
    Strong organizational skills and attention to detail;

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, disability, sexual orientation, national origin, or any other category protected by law.

Descrição da vaga
#VemSerMAG
Se você quer trabalhar com propósito, desenvolver sua carreira, mas sem deixar de lado sua saúde e bem-estar, a MAG é o seu lugar Temos em nosso DNA a inovação e o cuidado com as pessoas. Desde 2016 estamos na lista das melhores empresas para se trabalhar, segundo a Great Place to Work.
Somos uma empresa PLURAL
Diversidade e inclusão estão na pauta constante da MAG. Nos orgulhamos de ser uma companhia formada por mais de 80% de todos os nossos colaboradores pertencentes a, pelo menos, um grupo minorizado. Contamos também com o Plural, programa formal, estruturado e direcionado ao fomento da diversidade e inclusão.
Nosso propósito e valores
Estamos em busca de pessoas que tenham valores alinhados aos nossos: Atitude de dono, História de transformação, Relações duradouras e Ser presente.
Na MAG temos o forte propósito de oferecer soluções financeiras nos diversos momentos de vida de todos os brasileiros. Nos últimos três anos, realizamos o pagamento de mais de R$ 1 bilhão em benefícios a milhares de famílias. Dados como esse que nos levam a ser referência no mercado de Vida e Previdência, com quase 200 anos de atuação ininterrupta no Brasil.
Somos parte do Grupo Aegon, um dos maiores grupos de Seguro de Vida e Previdência do mundo. No Brasil, nossa força também impressiona: temos mais de 5,8 milhões de vidas seguradas e crescemos, em média, 16% ao ano na última década.
Quer fazer parte dessa história? Conheça a nossa oportunidade.
Responsabilidades e atribuições
Quais serão seus desafios:
Analisar a aprovar/recusar as solicitações de pagamentos à fornecedores, reembolsos, prestações de contas de adiantamentos, cartões corporativos, fundos fixos e demais obrigações da companhia;
Conferir notas fiscais, contratos e documentos de suporte, assegurando conformidade fiscal, tributária e contratual;
Analisar a aprovar/recusar o cadastro de fornecedores para pagamento;
Realizar atendimento, esclarecendo dúvidas sobre pagamentos, documentação e prazos;
Garantir o cumprimento dos prazos de pagamento, respeitando fluxo de caixa, políticas internas e aprovações de alçada;
Apoiar nas atualizações periódicas das políticas internas da Tesouraria e áreas relacionadas;
Apoiar auditorias internas e externas, fornecendo documentação e evidências quando solicitado;
Contribuir para melhoria contínua dos processos, mitigando riscos, gargalos e oportunidades de automação.
Requisitos e qualificações
O que esperamos de você:
Formação superior completa em Administração, Ciências Contábeis, Economia ou áreas correlatas;
Vivência prévia na área financeira (Tesouraria/Contas a pagar e receber);
Conhecimento em Excel no mínimo intermediário;
Noções de impostos indiretos e retenções (ISS, INSS, IRRF, PIS/COFINS, conforme aplicável);
Noções de controles internos, compliance e governança;
Disponibilidade para atuação híbrida, presencialmente de 4 a 8 vezes por mês no Centro do Rio de Janeiro. Caso seja colaborador(a) da MAG e resida fora do Rio, a atuação deverá ocorrer em unidade da MAG mais próxima à residência, na mesma frequência.
Será um diferencial se você possuir:
Desejável conhecimento sobre Reforma Tributária, especialmente os impactos operacionais no processamento de notas e pagamentos (Split Payment);
Atuação integrada com áreas fiscal, contábil e financeira;
Experiência com grandes volumes de processamento e análise de pagamentos.

Há mais de 190 anos temos como propósito prover soluções financeiras individuais nos diversos momentos de vida de todos os brasileiros.

title: Auxiliar em Saúde Bucal
description:
Sobre Nós Quer fazer parte de uma das maiores redes de clínicas odontológicas do Brasil? Há mais de 39 anos no mercado, o Grupo Clínicas Inteligentes é uma das maiores redes de clínicas odontológicas. Presente em mais de 20 estados, o nosso grupo é formado por 4 marcas que contam com a colaboração de 2100 colaboradores e um dos melhores corpos clínicos do Brasil. Com conceito de clínica popular, somos determinados a garantir o pronto atendimento em ambientes seguros, confortáveis e climatizados por um valor justo e acessível. Nós do grupo Clínicas Inteligentes somos apaixonados pelo que fazemos. Acreditamos que o atendimento humanizado contagia e motiva a todos que se relacionam conosco. O Grupo Clínicas Inteligentes informa que sua participação em nossos processos seletivos é gratuita e nenhum fornecedor ou terceiro está autorizado a cobrar valores para candidatura à vaga, treinamento, material didático ou qualquer outra despesa relacionada. Sobre a Oportunidade:Realiza coleta dos materiais nos consultórios para esterilização diária e guarda em lugar específico, para utilização dos profissionais/Dentistas, realiza a Limpeza e higienização dos consultórios, em específico, cadeiras, cuspideiras entre outros itens necessários e pertinentes a atividade. realiza a conferência diária dos equipamentos (consultórios, central de esterilização/autoclaves) a fim de que estejam em perfeito funcionamento, realizando a comunicação ao responsável imediato das irregularidades, formalizando as solicitações de manutenção junto ao movdesk (ferramenta específica empresa). realiza as atividades em atendimento as regras de segurança do trabalho e garantindo atendimento as normas de fiscalização e vigilância sanitária. Recepcionar pacientes no consultório dentário, procurando identificá-las e averiguar suas necessidades, para prestar informações ou encaminhá-las ao cirurgião dentista. Executar tarefas auxiliares ao trabalho do cirurgião dentista, visando a agilização dos serviços. Auxiliar o profissional, no atendimento aos pacientes, em tarefas tais como:segurar o sugador de saliva, fazer o afastamento lingual e alcançar materiais e instrumentos odontológicos, fazer a manipulação de material provisório e definitivo usado para restauração dentária. Preparar o material anestésico, de sutura, polimento, bem como procede a troca de brocas, fazer a separação do material e instrumentos clínicos em bandejas para ser utilizado pelo profissional. Zelar pela boa manutenção de equipamentos e peças, preparar, acondiciona e esteriliza materiais e equipamentos utilizados. Colaborar com limpeza e organização do local de trabalho consultórios, sala de esterilização e infecção. title: Analista de Farmacovigilância PL
description:
Analista de Fármaco Vigilância

Se você é apaixonado pela geração de demanda, movido por desafios, comprometido com os resultados e tem brilho nos olhos ao atuar com gestão de pessoas, essa oportunidade é para você #Vem Ser FQM

O Grupo FQM é uma empresa da Indústria Farmacêutica que atua há 93 anos no Brasil (desde 1992), faz parte do Grupo Roemmers, multinacional com sede na Argentina, posicionado entre os cinco maiores grupos farmacêuticos da América Latina. No Brasil, a FQM ocupa a 12ª posição do ranking da Indústria Farmacêutica com faturamento acima de 2 bilhões de reais ao ano. Com um amplo portfólio de medicamentos, suplementos, cosméticos atua em 02 segmentos: Medicamentos de prescrição médica (RX) em diversas especialidades terapêuticas, e consumo (OTC) produtos para o autocuidado, isentos de prescrição médica, destinados diretamente ao consumidor final.

A FQM, com mais de 1500 colaboradores, vem escrevendo sua história através de constante aprimoramento do seu portfólio de produtos e processos e da busca incessante pela inovação e excelência para atender às necessidades do mercado farmacêutico no país, promovendo Saúde, Autoestima, Bem-estar e Qualidade de Vida à toda população.

Local de trabalho:
Jacaré/Rio de janeiro.

Descrição Sumária

Conduzir análises técnicas de segurança de medicamentos, alimentos, cosméticos e produtos para saúde e garantir a conformidade regulatória dos produtos da FQM, por meio da avaliação de eventos adversos, implementação e manutenção do Sistema de Farmacovigilância, cumprimento de obrigações regulatórias e suporte às áreas internas, assegurando a proteção do paciente e a integridade dos nossos produtos.

Principais Responsabilidades


• Receber, avaliar, qualificar e investigar casos individuais de segurança (ICSRs), incluindo eventos adversos graves e não graves.


• Contatar notificadores para coleta de informações complementares e garantir completude e qualidade dos relatos.


• Determinar causalidade utilizando metodologias reconhecidas, assegurando consistência técnica na tomada de decisão.


• Acompanhar literatura científica e atualizar sistemas de segurança conforme requisitos de compliance.


• Realizar submissões de casos à Anvisa e demais autoridades regulatórias dentro dos prazos estabelecidos.


• Preparar documentação técnica e de suporte para Registro e Pós-registro, alinhada às normas vigentes.


• Elaborar e revisar relatórios periódicos de segurança (PSUR, RMPs e RPBR)


• Participar de auditorias internas, autoinspeções e avaliações de conformidade, garantindo alinhamento às diretrizes de Farmacovigilância.

description:

  • Manipulação de planilhas com openpyxl (estilos, fórmulas, múltiplas abas)
  • Git (fluxo de ramificações, revisão de código, rebase, tags);
  • Docker / docker-compose (ambiente isolado, build e solução de problemas);
  • JavaScript (ES6), Bootstrap em contexto de templates Django;
  • Integração com serviços externos (REST/SOAP ou WSDL; consumo resiliente);

    • Conhecimento prático de testes (pytest ou unittest; mocks; fixtures; cobertura);
  • Segurança básica web: CSRF, XSS, controle de acesso, saneamento de dados.

ESCOLARIDADE

Graduação: Administração, Engenharia, Contabilidade, Direito, Economia, Análise de Tecnologia da Informação, Administrador de Tecnologia da Informação ou outras áreas correlatas.

REQUISITOS DESEJÁVEIS

  • Experiência com sistemas de planejamento, logística ou operação offshore;
  • Modelo C4 / documentação arquitetural viva;
  • Otimização de consultas complexas;
  • Uso de linters (pylint), formadores (black/ruff/isort) e tipagem gradual (mypy);
  • Observabilidade (CloudWatch);
  • Conhecimento em otimização de geração de grandes arquivos em streaming (Excel).

ATRIBUIÇÕES

  • Evoluir e manter uma solução, garantindo qualidade, performance, segurança e escalabilidade, operando tanto no backend (Django + DRF + PostgreSQL) quanto no frontend (templates Django, JavaScript) e nas integrações (SAP, S3);
  • Implementar e evoluir APIs REST com Django REST Framework (versionamento, validação e serialização)
  • Desenvolver e manter recursos de escalonamento, carteiras e histórico de planejamento;
  • Criar e otimizar consultas e modelos no PostgreSQL (índices, transações, migrações consistentes);
  • Trabalhe com WebSockets (Django Channels) para atualizações em tempo real;
  • Implementar e manter exportações Excel (openpyxl) com regras de negócio complexas;
  • Integrar e monitorar rotinas de sincronização com sistemas externos (ex.: SAP);
  • Armazenamento manipulável de arquivos em AWS S3 (boto3).
    • Garantir integridade e segurança do sistema de permissões e perfis;
  • Contribuir com testes automatizados (pytest / unittest Django) e manter a cobertura mínima acordada;
  • Revisar PRs, propor melhorias arquiteturais e seguir padrões internos (lint, estrutura de apps, internacionalização);
  • Diagnosticar e otimizar gargalos de performance (DB, IO, memória, consultas N+1, websockets);
  • Evoluir gradualmente o frontend (melhor UX, modularização JS, possível modernização futura);
  • Apoiar pipeline CI/CD, conteinerização (Docker / docker-compose) e execução local consistente;
  • Documentar: endpoints, fluxos críticos, decisões técnicas e diagramas (C4 / README's técnicos);
  • Zelar por observabilidade (logs estruturados, considerações e tratativas de questões).

Na Capco promovemos uma cultura inclusiva. Valorizamos a diversidade em todas as suas expressões. 

Pensamos, em conjunto, sempre em ações diversas de inclusão e de responsabilidade social através de comitês internos geridos pela nossa comunidade interna, como os grupo de Mulheres, Pessoas Com Deficiência, Pessoas Negras, LGBTQIAPN+, Parentalidade, Gerações, entre outros.

title: Engenheiro de Poços Sênior
description:
Descrição da vaga

Somos a PRIO, a maior companhia independente de óleo e gás do Brasil. Buscamos continuamente por otimização de processos operacionais e de soluções inovadoras que visem diminuir os custos. Aqui todo trabalho é multidisciplinar e cada desafio é único

Estamos em busca de um(a) Engenheiro(a) de Poços Sênior para integrar a área de Engenharia de Poços, atuando de forma estratégica e técnica no planejamento, execução e otimização de poços offshore no Brasil, abrangendo poços subsea e surface.

Esse(a) profissional será responsável pelo ciclo completo do poço, desde as fases de conceito e planejamento até a execução, acompanhamento operacional e pós-poço, garantindo segurança, integridade, eficiência operacional e aderência a custos e cronogramas, em alinhamento com padrões corporativos e regulatórios.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Planejar, projetar e revisar programas de perfuração, completação e intervenção de poços subsea e surface, considerando requisitos técnicos, operacionais, econômicos e de HSE.
  • Atuar no acompanhamento técnico da execução offshore, suportando operações de perfuração, revestimento, cimentação, completação e testes, garantindo conformidade com o programa aprovado.
  • Avaliar riscos operacionais (well integrity, controle de poço, stuck pipe, perdas, estabilidade do poço) e implementar estratégias de mitigação alinhadas às melhores práticas da indústria.
  • Interface técnica com equipes de Operações, Subsea, Geologia, Reservatórios, SMS, Suprimentos e fornecedores de serviços (drilling contractors, service companies).
  • Liderar ou apoiar análises técnicas, revisões de projeto (DWOPs, peer reviews), AARs (After Action Reviews) e iniciativas de melhoria contínua.
  • Suportar processos de contratação e gestão de fornecedores, incluindo definição de escopo técnico, avaliação de propostas, acompanhamento de desempenho e controle de custos.
  • Contribuir para a padronização de processos, especificações técnicas, lições aprendidas e indicadores de desempenho (KPIs) de poços.
  • Garantir conformidade com requisitos regulatórios locais (ANP, IBAMA, Marinha) e padrões internos de governança e segurança de poços.

Requisitos e qualificações

Formação acadêmica;

  • Graduação completa em Engenharia (Petróleo, Mecânica, Química, Civil).

Experiência prévia;

  • Experiência sólida em Engenharia de Poços offshore no Brasil.
  • Vivência comprovada em campanhas de perfuração em águas profundas e ultraprofundas.

Qualificações necessárias

  • Conhecimento aprofundado em projetos de poços, controle de poço, integridade de poços e gestão de riscos.
  • Capacidade de atuar de forma integrada com múltiplas disciplinas e liderar discussões técnicas complexas.
  • Boa comunicação, organização, pensamento analítico e habilidade para tomada de decisão em ambientes operacionais.
  • Conhecimento em análise de desempenho operacional, AFE, estimativas de custo e acompanhamento de budget de poços.
  • Experiência com ferramentas e softwares de engenharia de poços (ex.: WellPlan, Wellcat, DrillPlan, Landmark, Drillbench ou similares).

Informações adicionais

Como é o processo seletivo na PRIO?
Gostamos de já chegar na entrevista te conhecendo um pouco, então pedimos a você que preencha ainda na etapa de cadastro alguns testes para podermos avaliar o seu Match com a nossa Cultura :)

Depois, nós do time de RH vamos marcar um papo com você. A ideia aqui é aprofundar um pouco mais nas suas experiências, buscando o alinhamento com o perfil da vaga e comportamental que buscamos para a PRIO. Ah, nesse papo também vamos falar sobre a companhia, fluxo do processo, benefícios e tirar suas dúvidas

Dica:
Nesse nosso papo, vamos querer saber sobre experiências que você já vivenciou, alinhadas aos valores da PRIO. A ideia é que você consiga nos apresentar essas vivências de forma completa, com contextos, sua responsabilidade, o que você fez e qual foi o resultado

Em seguida, vamos adentrando em aspectos mais técnicos, que podem envolver um case ou apenas uma entrevista com o(a) gestor(a) da vaga, aonde você poderá conhecer um pouco mais sobre os desafios técnicos da vaga e será avaliado dentro dos requisitos da vaga.

Ao fim, os finalistas conversam com o diretor da respectiva área para a escolha final

Como se preparar para o processo seletivo na PRIO:

  • Pesquise sobre o negócio da companhia e nossa atuação no setor de óleo e gás;
  • Busque se atualizar sobre as notícias recentes da companhia, sejam da imprensa ou divulgadas em nosso site de relações com investidores;
  • Acesses nossas redes sociais para conhecer mais sobre como é trabalhar na PRIO
  • Pense na sua história e principais realizações. Estruture seus resultados e conquistas para relatá-los na hora da entrevista.

Fale dos sucessos, mas entender as falhas e como você aprendeu com elas também é importante. Prezamos pela transparência, por isso, não tenha medo de falar sobre os seus insucessos.

Desejamos a você um bom processo seletivo

Venha fazer parte da PRIO

Somos a PRIO, a maior companhia independente de óleo e gás do Brasil. Buscamos continuamente por otimização de processos operacionais e de soluções inovadoras que visem diminuir os custos. Aqui todo trabalho é multidisciplinar e cada desafio é único

Com foco no investimento e na recuperação de ativos em produção, somos especializados na gestão eficiente de reservatórios e no redesenvolvimento de campos maduros. Acreditamos na condução dos negócios, com foco em segurança e cuidado com a saúde dos seus colaboradores.

Nosso ambiente de trabalho
Oferecemos um ambiente de trabalho dinâmico e com muitas oportunidades de participação em diferentes projetos, favorecendo o desenvolvimento profissional e o crescimento do time. Trabalhamos em um escritório
open space
, o que permite a integração entre todas as equipes e a Diretoria, onde todos podem participar da tomada de decisões.

Nossa cultura busca o alto desempenho e a participação efetiva de todas as pessoas. Se você sonha em se desenvolver junto com uma empresa em constante crescimento, venha fazer parte do nosso time

title: Aviation Logistics Specialist
description:
Important To make sure your application is considered, please submit it before the end of the day on ):

We encourage candidates to apply as soon as possible.

What does the job involve?

Responsible for management within one or more areas like sea surveillance, emergency preparedness, rig move operation, supply bases, helicopters, vessels, transportation, and other logistical assets. In this role, you will be responsible for ensuring safe, efficient and effective utilization of these assets to support operations. This includes coordinating with internal stakeholders, such as operations and maintenance teams, to ensure that logistical assets are available and operational when needed. Contribute to the organization's ability to deliver resources and services in a risk-based, timely and reliable manner.
You are utilizing your knowledge independently to solve highly complex tasks with a short to medium-term tactical impact/risk. You address key business challenges that align with Equinor's short and long-term strategy via providing specialist support to your team and others.​ ​You independently communicate within the immediate team, across other areas, and towards key stakeholders from partners or external parties. You regularly navigate conflicting agendas and may lead negotiations with senior stakeholders. You resolve challenges, deliver improvements and contribute to shaping best practices. You promote change initiatives, demonstrate flexibility to adopt new highly complex activities/ways of working and advice others.​ You follow and comply with safety, ethics, and compliance requirements and align with leadership expectations and company values. Full band description can be found on Insight. ​

What will my tasks be?

Within this position, your key tasks will be to:

  • Monitor and report on monthly Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) and follow-up actions to enhance operational performance. 

  • Drive initiatives aimed at improving aviation processes and procedures. 

  • Review and update operational procedures periodic to ensure compliance with industry standards and regulations. Stay updated on relevant aviation legislation and ensure compliance across operations. 

  • Follow up with air operator regarding maintenance planning and maintain an action log. 

  • Close follow up with Flight safety department in Norway. Set up and follow up on the annual flight safety verification process to ensure adherence to safety protocols. 

  • Identify cost accrual opportunities and implement reduction initiatives to optimize budget efficiency. 

  • Monitor and report on fleet availability to ensure optimal operational readiness. 

  • Collaborate with relevant stakeholders to enhance air traffic management and operational flow. 

Here's what we expect from you:

At Equinor, there are some overall qualities we regard as essential. We want you to identify with the values that guide our decisions and help us succeed and grow: open, collaborative, courageous and caring. We expect you to make safety your priority and to contribute to our zero-harm culture. And for this specific position, we are also looking for:

  • Minimum 10 years of relevant experience with aviation logistics. Bachelor's degree preferably in Mechanical or Aeronautical Engineering or related areas. 

  • At least 5 years of experience in helicopter maintenance and operations/logistics, OR similar field of study with proven experience in aviation engineering. 

  • Fluent in Portuguese and in English (written and spoken). 

  • Resilient, Communicative, great orator.

  • Collaborative spirit – focus on finding solutions alongside their team. Loves working as a team.

  • Proven experience in monitoring and analyzing aviation-related KPIs. 

  • Experience in reviewing and updating operational procedures in compliance with industry standards. 

  • Experience in maintenance planning and aircraft management. 

  • Ability to work under pressure attending multiple stakeholders. 

What can we offer you?

We want you to have a rewarding and fulfilling work life. That's why we offer:

Not just a job - a career

In Equinor, your development begins on day one. You will build your competence through a wide range of learning activities while being empowered to build your career across multiple disciplines and geographies. Our internal job market allows a wide range of opportunities for development and growth within your own field, or even in other areas you find interesting and relevant.

Attractive rewards

We give you a comprehensive benefits package with a competitive salary, global parental leave, bonus scheme and pension plan.

Wellness and work-life balance

We care about and prioritise our employees' well-being. We know that for you to be the best version of yourself in the workplace, being able to collect your children, attend a class or simply enjoy social time can be invaluable. That's why we encourage you to make use of our flexible work arrangements wherever possible.

An inclusive culture

We believe embracing our differences makes us stronger. For us, true inclusion means being able to bring your whole self to work, and for you and everyone else to feel accepted and valued.

Equal opportunities for everyone

Equinor is an equal-opportunity employer. We make all employment decisions, which include hiring, promotion, transfer, demotion, termination, and training, without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, marital status, parental status, veteran status, or any other protected status. 

As part of this commitment, reasonable adjustments will be made during the recruitment process for candidates with disabilities or long-term health conditions. If you have any specific requirements, please clarify this in your application and our team will be in contact to see how we can support your needs. 

Important notes about the application process

We expect you to openly offer all relevant information about yourself during the recruitment process. Background checks are performed on all final candidates, and all permanent and temporary hires will be screened using relevant sanctions lists to ensure compliance with sanctions laws. When applying for a job in Norway you will be asked for information on affiliation to high-risk countries for a security assessment.

About Equinor

Equinor is an international energy company headquartered in Norway, energising the lives of 170 million people worldwide. Our ambition is to be a leading company in the energy transition and achieve net zero by 2050. Our task is enormous: supplying the world with the energy it needs, while lowering emissions to the atmosphere. To achieve it, we are looking for like-minded people to join our team of 25,000 colleagues working in more than 20 countries. We're up for the challenge. Are you?

title: Offshore Maintenance Team Lead
description:
Imagine your career taking you to the depths of innovation and the heights of impact.  Our people enable continuous progress. Their commitment, collective expertise, and unique capabilities are the engine room behind SBM Offshore's True. Blue. Transition. - shaping the future of energy, and beyond.
About Us:
SBM Offshore is the world's deepwater ocean-infrastructure expert. Our work is already resulting in cleaner, more efficient energy production. True. Blue. Transition. is our promise to enable that into the future while at the same time using our expertise to support new and existing markets in the blue economy. Purpose


  • As Maintenance Lead, you are responsible for managing and executing the maintenance activities of an offshore unit. This role involves overseeing the maintenance backlog, coordinating with the maintenance superintendent and team, and ensuring that resources are effectively mobilized for major maintenance tasks. You are also responsible for maintaining the integrity of maintenance data, monitoring key performance indicators (KPIs), and supporting both corrective and planned maintenance efforts to ensure operational efficiency and safety.

    • Responsibilities


  • You manage the maintenance backlog for a specific offshore unit, ensuring that tasks are prioritized and executed efficiently.
  • You align with the Maintenance Superintendent and team to develop and implement strategies for effective backlog management.
  • You plan and mobilize resources for major maintenance activities, ensuring all necessary personnel, tools, and materials are available.
  • You coordinate with offshore supervisors and superintendents to ensure technical competency and effective execution of maintenance tasks.
  • You oversee the execution of routine maintenance offshore, ensuring adherence to safety and quality standards.
  • You update and maintain the unit's maintenance budget master plan, providing regular reports on progress and financial performance.
  • You ensure that the maintenance system is accurately populated with data, including the correct logging of corrective maintenance tasks.
  • You monitor the unit's maintenance KPIs to ensure that maintenance activities are aligned with operational goals and performance standards.
  • You approve purchase requisitions and oversee the CR (Change Request) process to ensure timely and appropriate procurement and maintenance adjustments.
  • You ensure that offshore supervisors and superintendents possess the necessary technical skills and knowledge to perform their duties effectively.
  • You develop and define the scope of work for planned shutdowns, ensuring that all maintenance activities are well-coordinated and executed.

    • Education

    • Experience

    Monitoring performance and compliance Workforce planning Analytics and reporting Cost Control and performance management execution Integrity and Reliability - Computarized Maintenance Management System Sub-contracting Change Management Risk Management Planning

title: Senior Manager, Catering
description:
Description


FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women's sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women's World Cup 2027 ("FWWC2027") that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION


The FIFA Women's World Cup 2027 (FWWC2027) will take place in June and July 2027, across eight stadiums in Brazil.

Reporting to the Head of Venue Operations, the Senior Catering Manager is responsible for the efficient organization of catering operations for FWWC2027 and all competition-related events. This includes catering services at competition and non-competition venues for multiple client groups such as workforce, media, broadcast, teams, match officials, ceremonies, and youth programmes, in close collaboration with all stakeholders.

The Senior Catering Manager will act as the first point of contact for all key deliverables related to catering services within venues, including sustainability, hygiene, kitchen equipment, space allocation, venue operations, etc. The role ensures consistency of in-venue catering across the tournament, meeting agreed quality standards at all venues.

This position requires effective and efficient management of catering operations, seamless coordination with FIFA's functional areas, and engagement with internal and external stakeholders. Key areas of focus include transparency, communication, problem-solving, innovation, issue escalation, and the use of reporting tools to guarantee operational excellence.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Plan and execute catering operations for multiple client groups during the FWWC and its competition-related events
  • Develop and coordinate catering service concepts aligned with client expectations and service levels.
  • Establish working relationships with key stakeholders, including public authorities such as ANVISA.
  • Produce technical specifications for catering requirements, equipment, and spaces to provide the required service at competition and no competition venues
  • Conduct full inventory of catering spaces and kitchen equipment at each venue and assign them per FIFA requirements.
  • Define strategic, operational, and technical requirements for catering tenders and procurement procedures to select catering for each stadium and any other relevant sites.
  • Provide operational input to the catering budget and oversee its execution.
  • Ensure project budgeting, reporting, and post-event debriefing for catering operations
  • Work closely with appointed venue caterers, FIFA functional areas, and stakeholders to ensure high-quality catering services
  • Negotiate measurable KPIs with caterers and ensure menu options are tested and meet quality standards for all user groups.
  • Oversee food safety and quality assurance of catering operations across all venues.
  • Integrate catering operational plans into overall venue plans.
  • Identify and mitigate risks across venues.

YOUR PROFILE


Education

  • University degree in appropriate subject (or adequate training/vocational education).
  • Bilingual - Brazilian Portuguese and English
  • Strong administrative and IT skills including MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).

Experience

  • Minimum of 8 years delivering catering services at international sporting events.
  • Proven strong record of experience in organizing catering services for complex events involving multiple venues, stakeholders and authorities.
  • Strong knowledge of local food and beverage regulations, including food safety standards applicable to sporting events.
  • Knowledge of event planning and event project management processes.
  • Excellent customer service experience, with references for excellence.
  • High level of presentation and negotiating skills
  • Excellent oral and written communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently and lead teams without formal reporting structure
  • Experience in budgeting, financial oversight, and resource management for large-scale events.
  • Excellent communication and crisis management skills, with the ability to remain calm under pressure and provide decisive leadership.
  • Familiarity with the host stadium and its operational environment will be considered an asset
  • Flexibility when faced with ambiguity or constant change
  • Strong IT skill including MS Office (Word, Excel, Visio, PowerPoint)

Skills & Competencies

  • Strong team player with ability to meet tight deadlines.
  • Solution-oriented mindset with resilience and positivity under pressure.
  • Ability to prioritize and manage high workloads during peak periods.
  • Sound judgment and critical problem-solving skills.
  • Effective leadership, motivational, and negotiation skills.
  • High energy, adaptability, and entrepreneurial spirit.
  • Excellent interpersonal skills across diverse stakeholder groups.
  • Cultural awareness and sensitivity, with experience in international contexts.

Certifications & Requirements

  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

About FIFA Women's World Cup 2027


The FIFA Women's World Cup is the greatest women's sporting event on the planet, showcasing the best players in the world on the biggest stage. In 2027, history will be made as Brazil welcomes the tournament to South America for the first time ever.

This landmark event will unite the world through an unprecedented celebration of women's football, inspiring billions of fans across the globe. As we prepare to host teams and supporters from every corner of the world, we're looking for passionate, talented individuals to be part of history and help deliver an unforgettable tournament.

Join us and play your role in making FIFA Women's World Cup 2027 a truly extraordinary experience that celebrates and elevates women's football.

Fundada em 1977 como "Cardiolab", atualmente conta com 75 hospitais próprios e 3 sob gestão, além de 55 clínicas oncológicas, nos estados do RJ, SP, MG, PE, BA, MA, SE, CE, AL, PB, PR, MS, PA e DF.

Gerencia diferentes marcas, tendo presença mais marcante no Rio de Janeiro, com a marca "D'Or"; em SP, com "São Luiz"; em PE, com "Esperança"; no DF, com "Santa Luzia" e "Santa Helena"; no MA, com "UDI"; na BA, com "São Rafael"; em SE, com "São Lucas"; no PR, com "Santa Cruz"; em MG, com "Biocor", em MS, com "Proncor", em PB, com "Nossa Senhora das Neves", em CE com "São Carlos", além da marca premium "Star" nos estados do RJ, SP e DF.

CMG is a worldwide leader in its field, thanks to its great staff who consistently deliver superior technology and unparalleled customer service.

The successful candidate will work as part of the Customer Success and Consulting team, under the direction of a Team Lead – CSC.
The successful candidate will:
Become very proficient with CMG's software suite, including the graphical pre- and post-processor.
Play an active role in supporting CMG clients who use the software for a variety of challenging and leading-edge petroleum reservoir recovery processes.
Teach advanced reservoir simulation training courses to CMG clients.
Become part of an international consulting team and work on conventional, unconventional, thermal, chemical, compositional and energy transition reservoir studies.
Will get an opportunity to develop broad knowledge and expertise in simulating various enhanced oil and gas recovery processes.
Develop knowledge and expertise in emerging energy transition topics such as subsurface and wellbore modelling of CCS/CO2 Sequestration, geothermal, hydrogen storage, etc.
Provide technical leadership and mentorship to junior engineers within the reservoir simulation team.
Act as a subject matter expert in reservoir simulation, providing guidance and expertise on complex projects and challenging technical issues.
Take a lead role in engaging with clients, understanding their needs, and providing high-level technical support and expertise.
Build and maintain strong client relationships, serving as a trusted advisor and consultant on reservoir simulation matters. Lead and oversee multiple reservoir simulation projects simultaneously, ensuring they are delivered on time, within budget, and to the client's satisfaction.
Coordinate with internal teams, including software development, technical support, and sales, to ensure seamless project execution and delivery.
The above statements are intended only to describe the general nature of the job and should not be construed as an all-inclusive list of position responsibilities.

Excellent technical and communication skills and a collaborative approach towards clients and colleagues.
Excellent analytical, troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
Self-motivated, results focused team player with a positive attitude and ability to multi-task in a dynamic work environment.

title: Search Engine Marketing
description:
Position is Remote (Canada, or Latin / South America)
No agencies please
Maximus ) is a mission-driven consumer performance medicine company that empowers individuals to achieve their physical and cognitive peak through precision telehealth care. We are a high-growth, profitable company tailored to ambitious people who refuse to settle for average. We are backed by top Silicon Valley VCs such as Founders Fund and 8VC as well as leading angel investors/operators from companies like Bulletproof, Tinder, Coinbase, Daily Stoic, & Shopify.
About The Role
We are looking for a highly technical Paid Search & YouTube Manager who thrives on intent capture, granular data analysis, and scientific rigor. In this role, you will be instrumental in transitioning our SEM and YouTube operations in-house, taking ownership of these critical high-intent channels to help us scale.
You will work directly with the Director of Paid Media to manage, execute, and optimize campaigns primarily on Google (Search & YouTube) and Microsoft (Bing). This role requires an individual who embodies "curiosity"—you never accept "that's just the way it is" or rely solely on automated bidding strategies without oversight. Instead, you dive deep into the Search Query Reports to understand the "why" behind performance. You will be expected to work transparently, sharing work queues and mid-stream insights to ensure alignment.
Key Responsibilities
Own Campaign Execution: Take end-to-end ownership of campaign setup, management, and optimization across Google Ads (Search, YouTube, Discovery/Demand Gen) and Microsoft Ads. You will lead the transition of these responsibilities from our current agency partners
Master Intent & Keywords: Meticulously manage keyword strategy. You will move beyond simple broad match reliance to build robust negative keyword lists, structure high-intent ad groups, and maximize Quality Score to improve efficiency.
Drive YouTube Performance: Treat YouTube as a direct-response performance channel. You will collaborate with the creative team to iterate on video hooks, pacing, and CTAs based on retention rates and conversion data, not just vanity view metrics.
Scientific A/B Testing: Rigorous A/B testing of headlines, descriptions, and extensions, and landing pages.
Master Attribution: Utilize internal analytics and multi-touch attribution (MTA) tools alongside platform data to triangulate performance.
Analyze & Iterate: Assist in the set-up and evaluation geo holdout tests to prove incrementality.
Work Transparently: Maintain visible work queues and rigorous reporting standards. You will prepare data for weekly paid media performance reviews to discuss budget shifts, CPA targets, and anomalies.
Qualifications
Platform Expertise: Deep, hands-on mastery of Google Ads and Microsoft Advertising is non-negotiable. You must have a track record of scaling direct-response accounts in a D2C environment.
Demand Gen / Youtube Experience: Proven experience managing YouTube for conversions (VAC/Demand Gen), not just brand awareness. You understand how to buy YouTube traffic that converts.
Tech Stack: Proficiency with 1st party analytics tools is essential (GA4, Looker, Tableau or the like). Preferred experience with (or similar tools to) MTA platforms (Northbeam, Triple Whale), and experience implementing tracking pixels (GTM).
Resourcefulness: You are scrappy. You use the tools in front of you to prove value and are willing to track down the information you need rather than waiting for it to be handed to you.
Data-Driven Mindset: You base your decisions on numbers, ROAS/CAC targets, and data, not assumptions.
Nice To Haves
Experience in the Health & Wellness, Telehealth, or Biohacking space.
Proven success utilizing Google Scripts or automated rules to streamline optimizations.
Experience using AI tools (Claude, GoMarble, Gemini) for platform strategy and analysis.
World-Class Benefits
Flexible vacation/time-off policies - we manage energy, not time and promote work life flexibility
Exposure to top-tier leadership and a meritocratic culture where the best ideas win regardless of title.
Opportunity to work with a high-growth, science-backed brand changing the landscape of performance medicine.
Opportunity to make a meaningful impact on people's health and wellness
Fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment with significant growth opportunities
Extended options exercise window for loyal employees (3 months for every year of service; e.g. 1 year for 4+ year employees)
Liquidity of options whenever available
Maximus is an equal opportunity employer, which not only includes standard protected categories, but the additional freedom from discrimination against your free speech and beliefs, as long as they are aligned with company values. We celebrate intellectual diversity.
Note: We utilize AI note-taking technology during our interview sessions to ensure we capture all answers and details accurately. Candidates are also encouraged to use AI note-takers for their own records if they wish.

title: Quality Engineer, Product QA
description:
Would you thrive in a role where technical rigor, product assurance and collaboration with cross‑functional manufacturing teams ensure flawless execution of in‑house production?
Would you bring the critical thinking, discipline and problem‑solving mindset needed to drive continuous improvement in fabrication, assembly and product validation processes?
Join our Quality Team
At Baker Hughes, Quality is essential to delivering safe, reliable and high-performing products. Our Product QA team ensures alignment with the Quality Management System (QMS), customer requirements and industry standards across internal manufacturing operations.
Partner with the best
As a Quality Engineer, Product QA (In-house Curitiba), you will ensure technical requirements are properly implemented and verified throughout fabrication, assembly and validation activities inside our Curitiba plant. You will support audits, risk assessments, first article inspections, non‑conformance management and continuous improvement initiatives to guarantee flawless execution.
As the Quality Engineer, Product QA (In-house Curitiba) you will be responsible for:
Reviewing and improving in-house product quality performance on a frequent basis.
Collaborating with Lean initiatives to enable process improvements and flawless execution.
Leading first article inspection (FAI) processes internally, ensuring product and process alignment with requirements using risk assessment tools such as FMEA.
Conducting product quality audits and performing routine Gemba walks to validate compliance to technical specifications.
Acting as a risk assessor for manufacturing processes and mitigating identified execution risks.
Supporting and/or leading Go/No-Go reviews and facilitating pre-production meetings.
Capturing, resolving and communicating operational Lessons Learned to Supply Chain and Product Delivery teams.
Promoting quality culture by conducting continuous improvement workshops.
Identifying, reviewing and addressing product non-conformances and driving strategic corrective actions.
Implementing and monitoring product Key Performance Indicators (KPIs).
Communicating approaches and methods for solving complex quality issues.
Ensuring adherence to Product Line quality directives at fabrication sites.
Witnessing in-house product inspections and qualification activities.
Registering and escalating critical observations to the appropriate levels of the organization.
Leading manufacturing review processes for new first articles with relevant stakeholders.
Acting as an enabler for implementing Non‑Conformance Management processes within internal operations.
Fuel your passion
To be successful in this role you will:
Have a Bachelor's degree in Mechanical or Production Engineering.
Have fluent English skills.
Have knowledge of Brazilian customer quality requirements for subsea equipment fabrication (XT, Manifolds, Tooling).
Have previous experience in Quality Control for subsea equipment fabrication.
Have experience performing quality and product requirement audits.
Have knowledge in product inspection processes and technical documentation analysis.
Have experience using quality tools such as A3, 8D, 5 Whys, Fishbone, FMEA, 5S and Lean Six‑Sigma.
Have strong leadership skills.
Have negotiation and influencing abilities with internal and external stakeholders.
Have the ability to interpret technical drawings, specifications and quality requirements.
Have a Master's degree in a Quality‑related discipline. (Desirable)
Have technical qualification or certification in Dimensional, Painting, Welding, NDT or Fabrication inspection. (Desirable)
Work in a way that works for you
We recognize that everyone is different and that the way in which people want to work and deliver at their best is different for everyone too. In this role, we can offer the following flexible working patterns:
Working flexible hours - from 7am-4pm or from 8am-5pm.
Location: Curitiba, PR.
Working with us
Our people are at the heart of what we do at Baker Hughes. We know we are better when all of our people are developed, engaged and able to bring their whole authentic selves to work. We invest in the health and well-being of our workforce, train and reward talent and develop leaders at all levels to bring out the best in each other.
Working for you
Our inventions have revolutionized energy for over a century. But to keep going forward tomorrow, we know we have to push the boundaries today. We prioritize rewarding those who embrace change with a package that reflects how much we value their input. Join us, and you can expect:
Contemporary work-life balance policies and wellbeing activities
Comprehensive private medical care options
Safety net of life insurance and disability programs
Tailored financial programs
Additional elected or voluntary benefits
The Baker Hughes internal title for this role is: Quality Senior Specialist - QA Engineering
About Us:
We are an energy technology company that provides solutions to energy and industrial customers worldwide. Built on a century of experience and conducting business in over 120 countries, our innovative technologies and services are taking energy forward – making it safer, cleaner and more efficient for people and the planet.
Join Us:
Are you seeking an opportunity to make a real difference in a company that values innovation and progress? Join us and become part of a team of people who will challenge and inspire you Let's come together and take energy forward.

description:

essa vaga é para você
Como
Pintor (a) Industrial

Nosso cliente
Uma das maiores e mais respeitadas empresas de metalurgia do Brasil. Com mais de 30 anos de ampla expertise, atua nas áreas de caldeiraria, serralheria industrial, ferramentaria e desenvolvimento de projetos para movimentação e armazenagem de materiais, localizada na Baixada Fluminense.

Inspeção e Preparação: Realizar a inspeção rigorosa das superfícies para garantir que as peças estejam devidamente preparadas para receber tintas, primers e vernizes;

Dimensionamento de Recursos: Calcular a quantidade correta de tinta para cada aplicação, observando a cobertura e uniformidade da cor;

Requisitos
O que esperamos de você
Ensino Médio completo;

Curso de Pintura Industrial;

Experiência consolidada em pintura de peças metálicas e chassis com uso de pistola;

Domínio técnico em processos de catalisação e diluição de tintas industriais;

Conhecimento em inspeção de superfícies e reparos de acabamento;

Perfil detalhista, focado em qualidade e comprometido com normas de segurança.

title: Fonoaudiólogo(a)
description:
MISSÃO:
Diagnosticar, planejar, propor e executar intervenções voltadas para o desenvolvimento de habilidades de linguagem e comunicação em crianças e adolescentes com Transtorno do Espectro Autista (TEA), atuando em equipe interdisciplinar e contribuindo para o desenvolvimento e o bem-estar dos aprendizes neurodiversos.
ATIVIDADES:
Acolhida/Contato Inicial com o Aprendiz, Família, Escola e Equipe Multidisciplinar
Realizar acolhimento inicial das famílias e dos clientes, escutando e legitimando queixas e expectativas para alinhamento com a intervenção proposta.
Coletar e selecionar informações do histórico do indivíduo e da família, bem como dados de equipes multidisciplinares e escolas.
Esclarecer possíveis dúvidas que a família, escola ou equipe interdisciplinar possam ter sobre nosso trabalho.
Avaliação e Desenvolvimento do Plano Terapêutico
Estabelecer vínculo com o cliente antes de iniciar o processo de avaliação, a fim de garantir maior fidedignidade nas análises realizadas.
Planejar e conduzir avaliações fonoaudiológicas utilizando protocolos específicos da área, bem como participar de avaliações interdisciplinares, sob supervisão técnica, assegurando a integração e a coerência das informações coletadas.
Redigir relatórios de avaliação e elaborar planos terapêuticos individualizados junto com a equipe interdisciplinar.
Definir carga horária e local de atendimento do cliente, em conjunto com a equipe interdisciplinar.
Intervenção
Implementar o plano terapêutico individualizado, realizando a seleção, indicação e aplicação de métodos, técnicas e procedimentos terapêuticos adequados para crianças e adolescentes com TEA, com suporte da supervisão técnica.
Aplicar técnicas baseadas em evidências, com ênfase nos métodos voltados para transtornos motores da fala e para comunicação aumentativa e alternativa.
Adaptar e modificar as intervenções conforme necessário, com base no progresso do aprendiz.
Registrar e monitorar o progresso do aprendiz, mantendo registros organizados e atualizados.
Coordenação, Monitoramento e Trabalho em Equipe
Participar ativamente de reuniões e discussões com a equipe interdisciplinar, incluindo terapeutas ABA, coordenadores e supervisores.
Respeitar e colaborar com profissionais de outras áreas, reconhecendo a supervisão do caso pelo supervisor ABA.
Receber supervisão da fonoaudióloga sênior da clínica, implementando feedbacks para aprimorar a prática clínica.
Demonstrar humildade para reconhecer erros e disposição para aprender e crescer profissionalmente.
Orientar e fornecer suporte às famílias, cuidadores e, quando apropriado, à equipe escolar.
ESCOLARIDADE/FORMAÇÃO:
Ensino superior completo em Fonoaudiologia, com registro ativo no Conselho Regional de Fonoaudiologia (CRFa).
Formação em intervenção motora da fala (PROMPT, DTTC, REST) e CAA (desejável).
Conhecimento em Análise do Comportamento Aplicada (ABA) e TEA.
Cursos complementares em Motricidade Orofacial e TEA (diferencial).
EXPERIÊNCIA PROFISSIONAL:
Experiência anterior de 6 meses na área.

title: Diretor(a) de Unidade
description:
Quer ser um diretor escolar de excelência? Vem com a gente
Assumir a direção de uma escola vai muito além de ocupar um cargo: é uma oportunidade única de impactar vidas e deixar um legado na educação. Aqui no Grupo Salta, oferecemos a chance de iniciar uma jornada que vai expandir ainda mais o seu potencial. Ao fazer parte do nosso time de diretores, você vai liderar uma das escolas do maior grupo de educação básica do Brasil, inspirando as vidas da sua comunidade escolar e deixando a sua marca no cenário educacional do nosso país.
Juntos, podemos construir um futuro em que a educação seja dinâmica, transformadora e fortalecida em uma cultura de excelência. Vamos transformar histórias: a sua, a nossa e a da educação de todo o Brasil.
O primeiro passo para a excelência começa aqui. Vem com a gente e faça parte desse legado
Responsabilidades e atribuições
Gestão da equipe pedagógica e administrativa: Supervisionar e orientar as equipes pedagógicas e administrativas, promovendo o desenvolvimento profissional e garantindo o alinhamento com as metas institucionais;
Gestão do calendário escolar, projetos e eventos pedagógicos da escola: Garantir o cumprimento do calendário escolar, considerando excelência, qualidade técnica, comunicação e alinhamento à cultura da escola, de todos os projetos e eventos pedagógicos;
Atendimento aos responsáveis: Manter um canal de comunicação eficaz e acolhedor com os pais e responsáveis, garantindo o esclarecimento de dúvidas, resolução de problemas e a construção de uma relação de confiança com a comunidade escolar;
Desenvolvimento de equipe: Promover a formação contínua de professores e funcionários, garantindo alinhamento às metas da escola e atualização pedagógica constante, além de realizar avaliações periódicas do desempenho docente, com feedback e suporte para aprimoramento;

title: Dynamics 365 CE Technical Architect
description:
Our client's Microsoft Business Solutions team is a Microsoft Gold Partner and leader in Microsoft software implementations for medium to large organisations, providing their clients with the ability to keep up with the ever-changing digital world by implementing Microsoft's Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) and Customer Engagement (CE) software from the Microsoft Dynamics 365 (D365) software line.

Role Overview

The Dynamics CE Technical Architect is a core team member of our client's customer delivery of Microsoft Dynamics 365 centred solutions. The architect will be involved in the business processes and solution design and will be hands on configuring and customising the implementation of Dynamics CE solutions working with both onshore and offshore development teams. The position may require business travel.

Job Location: Silema, Malta

Work Type: Hybrid

Job Type: Full-time, Permanent

Working Hours: GMT +1

Salary: Base + Benefits (Paid in Euros €)

Relocation: VISA & Relocation Package Included

Requirements

  • A University graduate with relevant degree within a computing or business discipline;
  • Microsoft Dynamics CRM Certifications (2016, D365) & Power Platform Certifications are desirable;
  • Strong technical & functional knowledge and understanding of Microsoft Dynamics CRM and Power Platform stack covering a wide spectrum of industries and sectors;
  • Minimum 10+ years of relevant and proven end to end implementation experience in Dynamics CRM configuration, customization, standard or customized workflows, dashboards, forms, views, integration, custom plugin development, report development;
  • Strong and proven experience in developing solutions that involve Power Platform (including Power Apps like Canvas, Model driven, Power Automate, Power BI, Power Pages, etc.)
  • Detailed knowledge and understanding of all areas within Customer Engagement including Sales, Marketing, Customer Service & Field Services;
  • Good understanding of Dataverse including customisations and development of Business Data Models for different solutions etc.;
  • Good understand of Microsoft Dynamics CRM Accelerators, industry templates and add-ons
  • Proven track record of leading technical team and successfully delivering a number of solutions for medium/ large customers, preferably across a number of business verticals (e.g. healthcare, finance, insurance etc.);
  • Proven ability to develop a clear understanding of clients' needs and the ability to incorporate them into a solution following effective design approach;
  • Experience of consultancy roles in software delivery;
  • Experience in a delivery-orientated IT environment using waterfall, agile and DevOps methodologies;
  • Adept at business requirement analysis, solution design, development, system verification and deployment strategies;
  • Ability to see the bigger picture and suggest solutions both within and outside the current implementation;
  • Experience in creation of demos, supporting pre-sales activities is an advantage;
  • Business process mapping, Fit Gap analysis, work package estimation, work breakdown structure, modelling and documentation experience;
  • Excellent understanding of Dynamics CRM DB Schema and Business Data Model including the customisation and development of Business Data Models for different solutions;
  • Broad understanding of software development lifecycle, development management, release management, data migrations, cut-over planning and hyper care support;
  • Strong knowledge of Azure DevOps & CI/CD pipelines;
  • Knowledge and understanding of .NET framework including extensive experience writing ASP.NET and C# code (not just limited to plugins/custom workflows) is a plus;
  • Additional Technical Skills: PCF Component development, TypeScript, Unit Testing of TypeScript/JavaScript, Unit Testing of .Net Plugins, Core technical skills, i.e. use of git for source control.

Responsibilities

The Technical Architect will work to implement various modules of Dynamics CRM working closely with client teams and business stakeholders.

  • Organise, execute, manage and document workshops, meetings and requirements sessions with the client representatives, project stakeholders, business analysts and consulting team;
  • Interface effectively with other members of the consulting team to arrive at best in class solution, and provide a sustainable and scalable solution architecture and application to meet client's requirements;
  • Deliver high quality business and software solutions & services to clients ensuring the implementation of best practices based on Microsoft Dynamics standards and supported configuration/ customizations;
  • Ensure completeness in meeting business requirements and take accountability for project deliverables including and not limited to project documentation, solution design, performance, reliability, testing features etc;
  • Deliver all consultancy and configuration work according to our project methodology, ensuring that all software applications are implemented successfully according to the SLA: on time and on budget;
  • Maximize usage of OOB features and provide technical design or develop/customize solution approach for identified gaps;
  • Contribute to activities as required including technical presales, building demo and proof of concept solutions for various client presentations;
  • Proactively skilling up on new versions and technology stack to be future ready;
  • Work on the creation of Dynamics 365 solutions and industry templates;
  • Meet and exceed customer expectations of business knowledge, skills and behaviour; Be a trusted advisor for our clients and help to provide solutions which can be upgrade ready;
  • Proactively identify business/ project/ technical/ support risks and provide suggestions to mitigate or communicate as necessary;
  • Proactively communicate progress updates to relevant parties both formally and informally;
  • Support practice development activities such as defining, solutioning and configuring industry specific solutions;
  • Be an active member of technical and design working groups within the practice;
  • In all activities, ensure timely completion of internal processes and mandatory trainings;
  • Drive for process improvement, feature reusability and other initiatives to maximize efficiency in delivery;
  • Carry out additional duties as may occur from time to time as instructed and agreed by the management team or supervisors;
  • Provide guidance and mentorship (technical/professional) to groom junior team members;
  • Represent our client's Microsoft Business Solutions team in a professional and positive manner at all times;
  • The Employee is required to follow our client's Information Security Policies (ISP and ISMP) at all times.

Whether it's great training and development, mobility opportunities or corporate responsibility volunteering activities – you'll gain a wealth of experiences on which to build a rewarding career. This sets out all the different ways you'll be rewarded at our client. Among other things, you can benefit from honest conversations about your career as well as a range of other rewards. In all these ways and more, they have created an environment that can bring out the best in you.

#Bethechange and #makethechange. Join our talented, successful team and make the leap into the future.

For this exciting opportunity they have put together a great package that combines a competitive salary with a bundle of extras including allowances, business travel allowances, certifications to support you in your career growth, private insurance, and medical insurance for you and your family.
